description.text: Night fills the wide rocky headland as driving rain and sea spray sweep across the stones. A dark lighthouse stands at the edge of the rocks, its lamp room unlit, and breakers explode below in white sheets. The storm batters the tower while low clouds race past, and the sea heaves beyond the headland.
Rain streaks through the night air over the rocky headland, and the unlit lighthouse rises dark against the racing clouds.
Wind roars across the exposed rocks and lashes rain against the tower.
A wave breaks below the headland and throws spray high against the stones.
The sea crashes and withdraws in a heavy wash around the rocks.
The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed.

Inside the base of the tower, a lighthouse keeper in a wet oilskin coat leans into a heavy door and pushes it shut against the gale. A lantern swings in the keeper's other hand, sending warm light over damp stone. The keeper crosses to a spiral staircase, grips the rail, and begins to climb while wind presses at the tower walls.
The heavy door opens onto the tower base, letting in a burst of storm light before the keeper forces it closed.
The door thuds shut, and the wind becomes a muffled pressure against the stone.
The keeper crosses the wet floor, takes hold of the spiral rail, and starts up the stairs.
Boots strike stone steps while the lantern creaks softly on its handle.
Warm lantern light slides across the curved wall and the first winding steps.
The camera holds a static shot.

The keeper climbs higher around the curving stairs, breathing hard, coat dripping, one hand sliding along the rail and the other holding the lantern aloft. Its flame throws shifting arcs of light across wet steps and close stone walls. Rain hammers the tower windows. Near the top, the keeper reaches the lamp-room door and closes a hand around its handle.
The keeper rounds the spiral stairs, lantern raised, as the damp walls catch its moving glow.
Labored breathing and creaking stairs mix with rain striking the tower windows.
The keeper climbs the last steps and reaches out for the lamp-room door.
Wind presses against the tower and the lantern handle taps softly against the door.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

In the lamp room, the keeper opens the brass lamp housing and turns the wick wheel. A flame catches, blooms, and steadies inside the glass. The keeper steps back as the great lens begins to rotate, gathering the light and sending a broad beam sweeping out into the storm, cutting through rain and darkness over the sea.
The lamp room holds the brass housing, the great lens, and the keeper's lantern glow against the dark glass.
The keeper opens the brass housing and turns the wick wheel with steady hands.
The flame catches and blooms, and the lens begins to turn as the keeper steps back.
The wick mechanism turns, the lens rotates, and wind and rain continue outside as the beam sweeps into the storm.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
